title: Optional hypotheses for independent Brain AI Libero V2 PAPER study
evidence_grade: Research notes and author-stated backtests, NOT independent verified profits; no external backtest rerun; never mandatory rules
methodological_warning: No preset win rate, no copy-paste thresholds, no cross-exchange parameter transfer, no fabricated support/resistance or order-flow. Prefer experiments with net fees, slippage, funding, OOS and rejection logs.

candidate_models.name: Selective 5m price momentum
candidate_models.hypothesis: Closed 5m impulse with confirmation from 15m/1h structure, taker flow/volume if available; consider rejection/breakout levels, and net reward versus friction.
candidate_models.evidence: SingleB FixedRR MOM-only historical backtest author reported 14,008 trades, 55.6% winners, +$8,814; different trailing variant had losing paper outcome. No independent forward proof of fixed RR variant.
candidate_models.test: Compare fixed-RR and ATR/structure exits net of Bitget fees; don't force any R:R or number of trades.

candidate_models.name: Selective mean reversion near support/resistance or VWAP
candidate_models.hypothesis: In a demonstrated range, identify completed-bar price rejection from a defensible support/resistance area or VWAP deviation; avoid blind countertrend entry.
candidate_models.evidence: Research hypothesis, not individually validated strategy; maker fill and adverse selection can erase profits.
candidate_models.test: Observe realistic taker/maker fill probability, trend/regime invalidation and spread.

candidate_models.name: Price x open interest x aggressive volume 5m-15m
candidate_models.hypothesis: Assess whether move is supported by fresh positioning and taker flow or is a short-covering/long-liquidation squeeze. A decline in OI is not intrinsically a side signal.
candidate_models.evidence: Methodology and code from public research; some 15m funding MR OOS gains were very small and not independently audited.
candidate_models.test: Verify timestamp availability, native Bitget definition, separate contribution to net PnL versus price-only baseline.

candidate_models.name: BTC-to-liquid-alt leader/follower
candidate_models.hypothesis: BTC 5m/15m impulse may precede ETH/SOL under stable recent correlation; trade only if causal delay is empirically present.
candidate_models.evidence: Published lead-lag 1m 31 OOS trades with +6.78% claim; incomplete signal code, insufficient sample and no independent verification.
candidate_models.test: Out-of-sample lead/lag effect by asset, cost and volatility regime.

negative_evidence: Momentum 1m models can appear profitable before trading costs yet fail when commissions and leverage are included.
High win rate alone does not imply net profit; trailing can underperform fixed exits on a particular historical sample.
Simple OHLCV backtests may assume ideal stop/target order inside the same candle and ignore late data.
